node.statement: Algebraic identity lemma: let P:V->V satisfy P^2=P, put A=Im(P), and let v:B->A be a bijection, regarded as a map B->V. Define D~=v and U~=v^(-1)P. Then D~U~=P and U~D~=I_B. Indeed P(x) lies in A, so for every x in V, D~U~(x)=v(v^(-1)(P(x)))=P(x). Also P restricts to I_A: if a=P(y), then P(a)=P^2(y)=P(y)=a. Thus for b in B, U~D~(b)=v^(-1)(P(v(b)))=v^(-1)(v(b))=b.
